written.title: Fans Issue GTA 6 Spoiler Warnings as 'Cyberleek' Returns With New 24-Minute Gameplay Video
written.description: What Eurogamer, GamesRadar+, IGN, Kotaku, PC Gamer, Rock Paper Shotgun and VGC reported about Jason Duval, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Jason Duval, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## Eurogamer, 8 October 2026

[Full-frontal nudity, dirt-biking, and a dev menu: GTA 6's infamous leaker is back with the most X-rated look at the game yet](https://www.eurogamer.net/gta-6-frontal-nudity-dirt-biking-dev-menu-leak)

The outlet's own summary:

> A megaton leak has just emerged for Grand Theft Auto 6.

> 26 comments Follow Grand Theft Auto VI Prioritise us on Google It looks like the GTA 6 leaker, 'CyberLeek' is back - and this time the infamous leaker has posted a 25-minute video of footage from Rockstar's upcoming game that even features nude scenes, including a fully naked Jason, and a topless Lucia.

> Jason wanders around a garage and chooses which bike he'd like to rent to take part in the festivities.

> Then, for over 10 minutes of the footage, Jason is completely naked.

> Towards the end of the footage, we see Lucia in a thong and topless, preparing for a base dive (it looks like the same one that was initially shown in the Netflix reveal ) - albeit this time it's night time, and she is mostly naked.

## GamesRadar+, 8 October 2026

[GTA 6 leaker Cyberleek returns with 25 minutes of new gameplay after over a month of silence, showing first-person footage and more](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-leaker-cyberleek-returns-with-25-minutes-of-new-gameplay-after-over-a-month-of-silence-showing-first-person-footage-and-more/)

The outlet's own summary:

> And a lot of naked Jason

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> So basically, if you don't want any spoilers for GTA 6, I'd probably start muting some terms on social media right about now, because this could be the start of a new string of leaks.

> Games Action Games Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 GTA 6 leaker Cyberleek returns with 25 minutes of new gameplay after over a month of silence, showing first-person footage and more News By Scott McCrae Published 8 October 2026 And a lot of naked Jason When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission.

> You can play as Jason with his ding dong exposed." Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: Since this was posted, the footage has since been shared on social media by users, confirming the details outlined by TexFunz2.

> This includes cutscenes, in-game racing events, and a ton of naked Jason gameplay.

> This featured a ton of gameplay footage, a leak of the game's apparent map, and some story moments like a four-minute clip of Lucia's prologue in-game, dropping the first batch of story spoilers.

## IGN, 8 October 2026

[Fans Issue GTA 6 Spoiler Warnings as 'Cyberleek' Returns With New 24-Minute Gameplay Video](https://www.ign.com/articles/gta-6-leaker-returns-with-new-24-minute-gameplay-video-sparking-spoiler-concern)

The outlet's own summary:

> GTA 6 leaker Cyberleek has returned to publish a 24-minute gameplay video that has left fans scrambling to issue spoiler warnings across the internet.

> In Pictures: How GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Have Evolved Since 2023 View 13 Images Indeed, at one point in today's leaked video, what looks like a developer menu is used to spawn a tank, which you wouldn't expect would be possible in the launch version of the game.

## IGN, 8 October 2026

[No, I Have Not Seen Jason’s Penis in GTA 6 – but Does That Mean There’s No Junk, or Was It Just a Carefully Positioned Camera?](https://www.ign.com/articles/no-i-have-not-seen-jasons-penis-in-gta-6)

The outlet's own summary:

> IGN cannot confirm or deny if GTA 6 will feature full-frontal nudity, but we can confirm that we have not seen Jason's penis.

> Back To Top Home › News › GTA 6 No, I Have Not Seen Jason’s Penis in GTA 6 News from the frontlines of genital journalism.

> The fact that I may or may not have seen protagonist Jason Duval’s penis was not particularly high on that list.

> In my coverage, I mentioned a scene in which Jason is naked in the shower.

> For the sake of journalistic accuracy, I feel compelled to clarify: I did not see Jason’s penis.

> I appreciate that this may be disappointing news to those hoping for an exclusive report on the state of Jason’s anatomy, but I can only write about what I’ve actually seen.

> Of course, if Jason does indeed have a fully-rendered penis, he won't be the first GTA character to have one.

## Kotaku, 8 October 2026

[Massive GTA 6 Leak Reveals Story Spoilers, Action, And Jason In The Nude](https://kotaku.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-leak-cyberleek-nudity-jason-footage-2000742598)

The outlet's own summary:

> The lengthy portion of the game features cutscenes, dirt bike racing, and...Jason's winky

> If you don’t want to know anything that happens, maybe switch off your internet today.

> Jason fully clothed. © Rockstar It seemed inevitable that attention-seeking, crypto-shilling leaker Cyberleek wouldn’t be able to stay out of the limelight for long, after absconding with a sizeable chunk of change .

> But his return is entirely unlike previous minute-long clips; this is a 25-minute video of the game, packed with story spoilers and and Jason in the buff.

> Penis The video begins with a cutscene featuring both Jason and Lucia visiting a trailer-based store, changing clothes, and then taking part in a dirt bike race as part of a scripted mission.

> It then awkwardly cuts to show Cyberleek’s tedious attempt to shill his crypto coin once more, before cutting to a naked Jason sat on his motorbike.

> Another crummy edit takes us to a spoof ad for a care, and then another to a red-haired Jason, still in the nude, chatting with a guy at a beach-side coffee store.

> The cutscene plays out with a tattooed Jason, completely naked, talking to another character about car racing.

> It’s all very incongruous and mildly amusing, and I’m pleased to report Jason has nothing to be ashamed of.

> We then see footage of Jason tuning a car engine in what looks like quite a complicated setup, before a first-person driving view as Jason learns to drive with nitrous, and then a big street race.

> The very last moment shows Cyberleek playing as Lucia for the first time ever, wearing nothing but a thong, but only seen from behind, as she climbs up some sort of structure.

## PC Gamer, 8 October 2026

[Jason may or may not appear fully nude in GTA 6, but either way we've now seen his dong](https://www.pcgamer.com/games/grand-theft-auto/jason-may-or-may-not-appear-fully-nude-in-gta-6-but-either-way-weve-now-seen-his-dong/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Cyberleek's back, this time with nude Jason riding a dirt bike.

> Popular The PC Gamer HYPERFEED October Prime Day Clips GTA 6 Quizzes Games Action Grand Theft Auto Grand Theft Auto 6 Jason may or may not appear fully nude in GTA 6, but either way we've now seen his dong News By Tyler Wilde Published 8 October 2026 Cyberleek's back, this time with nude Jason riding a dirt bike.

> The most notable thing about the clip-or most noticeable , at least-is that protagonist Jason spends much of it naked.

> It's also notable that NPCs do not react to Jason's nakedness, and that the video shows first-person driving, a feature GTA 6 was previously reported not to include.

> GTA 6 co-protagonist Lucia also appears topless in the Cyberleek clip, facing away from the camera and wearing a thong.

## Rock Paper Shotgun, 8 October 2026

[Rockstar-hunted GTA 6 leaker seemingly strikes again, showing off series' most plentiful helping of onscreen johnson since San Andreas starred Carl](https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/rockstar-hunted-gta-6-leaker-seemingly-strikes-again-showing-off-series-most-plentiful-helping-of-onscreen-johnson-since-san-andreas-starred-carl)

The outlet's own summary:

> The GTA 6 leaker Rockstar are already on the hunt for appears to have returned with new footage of protagonist Jason running around nude.

> A fair chunk of those hijinks have been gotten up to while protagonist Jason's in the buff, his bare bum and wiggling weenie out for all of Leonida to gawk at.

> Following that is something far less sexy than Jason's meat and two veg.

> There's a tease of some Lucia top-half nudity at the end, though she is still wearing a thong.

## VGC, 8 October 2026

[As Rockstar continues to hunt for the GTA 6 leaker, they’ve returned with 25 minutes of nudity-heavy gameplay | VGC](https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/as-rockstar-continues-to-hunt-for-the-gta-6-leaker-theyve-returned-with-25-minutes-of-nudity-heavy-gameplay/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Cyberleek is seemingly using the clip to raise money for an ‘expensive’ gaming-related project…

> It shows protagonists Jason and Lucia buying new clothes for the event, before speaking to some dirt racing competitors.

> It then shows Jason taking part in one of these dirt races, against a variety of bikes and cars.

> After this, the footage turns notably X-rated, with Jason being fully nude for around 14 minutes of footage, with realistic ‘dangling’ physics on display.

> This includes a sequence in which Jason gets a car, takes it to a custom garage to get it upgraded and get new decals for it, then takes it on a street race.

> If it’s the latter, the fact that Jason appears fully nude may also have been manipulated by the leaker, and may not be in the full game.

> The footage ends with a tease of Lucia – wearing a small thong and topless – running up to the top of a tower and preparing to jump off it.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
